long_biography.plain_text:
Steidle-Sailer, a German civil engineer from the Lake Constance region, developed Sailing-Classics after deciding that individual travellers had little access to voyages on large classic-style sailing vessels. He worked with a designer and Turkish shipyard on the first schooner, and the company began operating in 2007. After an early setback, he relaunched the business and brought in additional investors five years later to finance further expansion.

He remains identified with the company as its founder, although other executives now lead day-to-day operations. Sailing-Classics offers crewed voyages through German and Dutch entities and continues to seek outside capital for new projects. His full name, Andreas Felix Steidle-Sailer, and birth date of 15 February 1959 connect the founder to the same Stuttgart business network. He founded and managed the business and held a shareholder role, while the company and investment entities—not Steidle-Sailer personally—hold their respective vessels and operating assets.
